title: Italian Fried Potato Pilaf
description: A crispy Italian-style pilaf made with fried potatoes, fluffy rice, and mediterranean spices.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced sweet potato and cook for 5 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Add fluffy rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add fried onions, pilaf, and mediterranean seasoning. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the rice is lightly toasted.
Optional: garnish with additional fried onions and a sprinkle of parmesan cheese.
